name: Blog Hero
description: Wide header image for blog posts and articles

show_brand.description: Show brand name/handle watermark at bottom. Default: false.

bg_image.description: Background image — local path or http(s) URL (PNG/JPG/WebP). Rendered with configurable opacity behind gradient overlay. Position it with bg_image_scale / bg_image_x / bg_image_y.

bg_image_scale.description: Zoom factor of the background image (1.0 = cover fit; up to 5.0).

bg_image_x.description: Horizontal focal point of the background image (0.0 left .. 1.0 right).

bg_image_y.description: Vertical focal point of the background image (0.0 top .. 1.0 bottom).

bg_image_opacity.description: Opacity of background image (0.0-1.0). For dark artwork use ~0.55 so the photo stays visible under the overlay.

bg_image_overlay.description: Opacity of the gradient overlay on top of the background image (0.0-1.0). Lower values let more of the photo show through; text contrast depends on it.

logo.description: Brand logo path (PNG/SVG). Rendered at bottom-right corner.
